roundOneFailure.cause: The final private launcher change in 5b3e324c (#368) gave Node the native Codex ELF binary as a JavaScript script. The protected JavaScript wrapper launch added by 16fdb41e (#371) was valid.
roundOneFailure.classification: Reproduced defect, not a flake or a private-capabilities credential-delivery failure.
roundOneFailure.laterFixture: The later private-turn driver still used the removed POST /credentials endpoint. It now installs a signed throwaway token through authenticated root Pod exec and standard input.
